item.title: ‘¡Viva México!’ Harry Styles Kicks Off His GNP Seguros Stadium Residency: 5 Best Moments
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music news and updates. Today, we're talking about Harry Styles' highly anticipated Mexico City residency. Let's get into it!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "Harry Styles kicked off his six-night residency at the GNP Seguros Stadium in Mexico City on July 31st, with a show that wowed over 68,000 fans. The British pop superstar brought his A-game, performing a setlist that blended hits like 'As It Was,' 'Watermelon Sugar,' and 'Sign of the Times,' with tracks from his latest album, Kiss All The Time."
[Short music clip: "As It Was" by Harry Styles]
Host: "The crowd was treated to a 120-minute dance party, with Styles showing off his pop music chops. But what made the show even more special was his connection to the city and its people. Styles expressed his gratitude to the Mexican fans, thanking them for their warm welcome and even speaking a few phrases in Spanish."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The residency is expected to bring in a significant economic boost to the city, with estimates ranging from $145 to $171 million. And with five more shows to go, it's clear that Harry Styles is making a lasting impact on Mexico City. The city is one of seven worldwide chosen by Styles to perform in during 2026, and the only one in the region hosting six concerts."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today's episode. If you're a Harry Styles fan or just love music, be sure to tune in for more updates and news. And if you're lucky enough to be in Mexico City, catch one of the remaining shows – it's sure to be an unforgettable experience!"
[Outro music continues to play]
